cleanup.method: Windows Recycle Bin; original attachments and unrelated caches preserved

correction: 2026-10-14: these are technical and editorial iterations, not three independent visual design passes. Owner rejected the result.
qaMediaRetention: 2026-10-14: QA screenshots and recordings removed from workspace at owner request. Historical filenames are metadata only; production media and user attachments remain sources.

subsequentReleaseOwnerAcceptance.feedback: The owner liked the desktop, especially GSAP, then confirmed the same level on mobile.
subsequentReleaseOwnerAcceptance.scope: Final redesigned release; historical small technical cycles remain distinct from design acceptance.
